issue.title: bob ref sync with a relative lib/ PDF path plans a duplicate top-level ref note and reading task

task_type_fields.impact: Without --dry-run, `bob ref sync <relative path>` writes a second ref note at ref/<stem>.md and files a duplicate v2 reading task (-2 block id) in the parent note, which then syncs to every host via vault-sync. Anyone (or any agent) following the docs' `bob ref sync <pdf>` examples with a relative path is affected; absolute and ~ paths are fine.
task_type_fields.repro: From the vault root on athena (2026-10-18, installed bob): `cd ~/bob && bob ref sync lib/chat/qmd_agent_vault_search.pdf --dry-run` prints `note: /home/bryan/bob/ref/qmd_agent_vault_search.md`, `note_action: create`, `reading_task: insert bob.md ^ref-qmd-agent-vault-search-2`. The same PDF as an absolute path (`bob ref sync ~/bob/lib/chat/qmd_agent_vault_search.pdf --dry-run`) correctly prints `note: .../ref/chat/qmd_agent_vault_search.md`, `note_action: none`. Root cause: `required_path` only expands `~`; `pdf_path_metadata` then does `pdf.strip_prefix(&config.lib_dir)` against an absolute lib_dir, which fails for a cwd-relative path, so it falls through to the legacy flat `ref/<stem>.md` target with no ref_type. Fix: make the PDF argument absolute against the current directory (and lexically normalize) before mapping, for `sync` and `marker`; add a regression test running sync with a relative lib/ path from the vault root.

issue.creation_reason: Found while timing single-PDF syncs for the ref-scan automation research: a relative path silently bypasses the library mapping and would write a duplicate note and reading task.

evidence.note: Independent repro on athena 2026-10-18 at bob-cli 674c9f5 with a different PDF: from ~/bob, 'bob ref sync lib/chat/pypi_release_reliability_design_and_work_split.pdf --dry-run' plans note ref/pypi_release_reliability_design_and_work_split.md, note_action: create, reading_task: insert sase.md ^ref-pypi-release-reliability-design-and-2; the absolute path reports ref/chat/..., note_action: none, reading_task unchanged. Code read confirms required_path (note.rs:703) only expands ~ and pdf_path_metadata (io.rs:10) strip_prefix(lib_dir) fails for cwd-relative input. Also matters for the proposed create-time scoped ingest: any new finish_intake path must canonicalize PDF paths.

payload.entry: Verified by lander bob-cli-an.6.6, 2026-10-24. Commit fb535ef6 (phase bob-cli-an.6.6.5) makes ref sync and ref marker (the only required_path callers) resolve the PDF argument against the cwd with the existing lexical normalizer before library mapping. A CLI regression covers sync and marker with lib/chat/../chat/<stem>.pdf from a scratch vault root. Live dry-run in ~/bob on athena with the installed binary: bob ref sync for the relative lib/chat/11q_w0_early_wait_release.pdf, the ./ spelling, and the absolute spelling all report note ref/chat/11q_w0_early_wait_release.md, note_action: none, the same reading task (done/sase_done.md ^ref-11q-w0-early-wait-release), and writes: none. No flat ref/<stem>.md is planned. just check passes on integrated master.
